## JobsPipe

Hosted Model Context Protocol server for live, normalized job search across 30+ ATS feeds and job boards. Connect at `https://mcp.jobspipe.dev/mcp` over streamable HTTP, sign in with a free JobsPipe account when prompted, and let agents search postings by title, skill, country, remote, and seniority. Docs: https://docs.jobspipe.dev
